roadmap.title: First Normal playthrough: story, quests and Cube recipes
roadmap.description: Pick any class and clear Acts 1-5 on Normal. Hire each of the four mercenaries, activate every waypoint, finish all 27 act quests, and try the Horadric Cube recipes along the way. Kills, gold and vendor sales build up by themselves.

roadmap.title: Nightmare playthrough
roadmap.description: Clear the game on Nightmare. Keep picking up gold and selling items, and watch for the Ort rune and good drops.

roadmap.title: Hell with every class and endgame items
roadmap.description: Clear Hell with each of the seven classes, plus the Warlock. Farm for a Stone of Jordan, a full set, unique gear, the Prismatic Amulet and the Standard of Heroes keys as you go.

roadmap.title: Long grinds: Level 99, Hardcore and extras
roadmap.description: Take a Hardcore character to Level 99 and through the game. Finish Level 99 on any character, gamble for a unique with spare gold, and collect 20 player ears in PvP.

achievements.summary: Defeat 500 enemies.

achievements.description: Pick up 500,000 Gold
achievements.summary: Pick up 500,000 gold.

guide.context: Only gold picked up from the ground counts. As a @mechanic{Necromancer}, collect the gold yourself instead of letting summons do it.

steps.text: Pick up gold dropped by monsters and chests until the counter unlocks.
If it does not unlock, drop your gold on the ground and pick it up again.

achievements.description: Pick up 1,000,000 Gold
achievements.summary: Pick up 1,000,000 gold.

guide.context: Gold drops grow with each act and difficulty. A friend can drop gold for you to pick up.

steps.text: Keep picking up gold from monsters and chests, and drop and re-pick your own gold if it stalls.

achievements.description: Socket a gem into an item
achievements.summary: Put a gem into a socket on an item.

guide.context: Use a @item{Horadric Cube} to add a socket if the item has none.

steps.text: Use a body armor, helm, shield or weapon with an empty socket, and insert any gem into it.

Speed it up with experience shrines, party play, and @loc{Terror Zones}.

achievements.displayName: I'm gonna do what's called a pro gamer move
achievements.description: Reach Level 99 with a Hardcore Character
achievements.summary: Hit character level 99 on a Hardcore character.

guide.context: A Hardcore character that dies is lost, so you must start a new one. Level 99 usually takes well over 100 hours.

steps.text: Create a Hardcore character and level it to 99 without dying.
Play defensively; one death ends the character.

achievements.description: Use the Horadric Cube to Create a Perfect Gem
achievements.summary: Combine three Flawless gems of one type into a Perfect gem in the Horadric Cube.

guide.context: Each gem grade needs three gems of the grade below, so you start from Chipped gems.

steps.text: Collect three Flawless gems of the same type, for example three Flawless Rubies.
Put them in the @item{Horadric Cube} and press Transmute.

achievements.displayName: All the colors of the rainbow
achievements.description: Use the Horadric Cube to Create a Prismatic Amulet
achievements.summary: Make a Prismatic Amulet in the Horadric Cube.

steps.text: Get a magic amulet and one Perfect gem of each type: Amethyst, Diamond, Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire and Topaz.
Put all seven items in the @item{Horadric Cube} and press Transmute.

achievements.description: Repair and Recharge a Weapon with the Horadric Cube
achievements.summary: Use the Horadric Cube to both repair and refill the charges of a weapon.

guide.context: Three @item{Ral} runes can be cubed into one Ort.

steps.text: Get a throwing weapon such as a javelin and use some of it so its count drops.
Get an @item{Ort} rune and any Chipped gem.
Put the weapon, the rune and the gem in the @item{Horadric Cube} and press Transmute.

achievements.description: Unsocket a Piece of Equipment using the Horadric Cube
achievements.summary: Remove the gems and runes from a socketed item with the Horadric Cube.

guide.context: The sockets are cleared and everything socketed in them is destroyed.

steps.text: Put a @item{Hel} rune, a Scroll of Town Portal and a socketed item in the @item{Horadric Cube} and press Transmute.

achievements.description: Obtain the Standard of Heroes
achievements.summary: Obtain the Standard of Heroes.

guide.context: You need level 90 to use the Standard. Another player can also drop one for you.

steps.text: On Hell, collect three of each key. @enemy{The Countess} drops Key of Terror, @enemy{The Summoner} drops Key of Hate, and @enemy{Nihlathak} drops Key of Destruction.
Cube one of each key to open a portal. Do this three times to reach @loc{Matron's Den}, @loc{Forgotten Sands} and @loc{Furnace of Pain}. Repeats are possible, so make all three in one session.
Defeat @enemy{Lilith}, @enemy{Uber Duriel} and @enemy{Uber Izual} to get the Brain of Mephisto, Eye of Baal and Horn of Diablo.
Cube the three organs and enter the portal to @loc{Uber Tristram} from @loc{Harrogath} on Hell.
Defeat @enemy{Uber Mephisto}, @enemy{Uber Baal} and @enemy{Pandemonium Diablo} to receive the Standard of Heroes.

achievements.displayName: I'll give you 8 SoJ for it
achievements.description: Obtain the Stone of Jordan
achievements.summary: Obtain a Stone of Jordan.

steps.text: Farm bosses on Nightmare or Hell for a Stone of Jordan ring; @enemy{Andariel} is the best choice.
Or ask another player to drop one for you.

achievements.description: Hire a Rogue Scout
achievements.summary: Hire a Rogue Scout.

steps.text: Finish the Act 1 quest @loc{Sisters' Burial Grounds}.
Hire a Rogue Scout from @npc{Kashya} in the @loc{Rogue Encampment}.

achievements.description: Hire a Desert Mercenary
achievements.summary: Hire a Desert Mercenary.

steps.text: In @loc{Lut Gholein}, hire any Desert Mercenary from @npc{Greiz}.

achievements.description: Hire an Iron Wolf
achievements.summary: Hire an Iron Wolf.

guide.context: Finishing @loc{Blade of the Old Religion} makes her hire free.

steps.text: In @loc{Kurast Docks}, hire an Iron Wolf from @npc{Asheara}.

achievements.description: Hire a Barbarian
achievements.summary: Hire a Barbarian.

steps.text: Finish the Act 5 quest @loc{Rescue on Mount Arreat}.
Hire a Barbarian from @npc{Qual-Kehk} in @loc{Harrogath}.

achievements.description: Collect 20 player ears
achievements.summary: Collect 20 player ears.

guide.context: Another player can also trade you ears.

steps.text: Turn on PvP in a multiplayer game, with both players at level 9 or higher.
Defeat 20 players; each drops an ear. Keep every ear in your inventory.

achievements.displayName: Maybe I should set up my own shop?
achievements.description: Vendor 1,000 items
achievements.summary: Sell 1,000 items to vendors.

steps.text: Sell items to any vendor until the counter unlocks.

achievements.displayName: They see me rollin', they hatin'
achievements.description: Equip all inventory slots with unique items
achievements.summary: Wear a unique item in every equipment slot.

guide.context: Unique items drop rarely, so never sell one.

steps.text: Equip a unique item in each slot: helm, amulet, body armor, weapon, off-hand, both rings, belt, gloves and boots.

achievements.displayName: It wasn't all a bad dream
achievements.description: Complete the game on Nightmare difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Nightmare difficulty.

guide.context: Nightmare opens after you finish Normal.

steps.text: Finish Act 5 on Nightmare.

achievements.displayName: Is it warm in here or was that you?
achievements.description: Complete the game on Hell difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Hell difficulty.

guide.context: Hell opens after you finish Nightmare.

steps.text: Finish Act 5 on Hell.

achievements.description: Complete the game with each class on Hell
achievements.summary: Beat Hell with every character class.

steps.text: Finish Hell with the Sorceress, Necromancer, Paladin, Barbarian, Amazon, Druid and Assassin.
Also finish Hell with the Warlock to be safe.

achievements.displayName: You ain't hardcore, unless you live hardcore
achievements.description: Complete the game with a Hardcore character
achievements.summary: Beat the game once with a Hardcore character.

guide.context: Combine it with the Hardcore level 99 goal. A death ends the character, so start a new one.

steps.text: Finish Act 5 with a Hardcore character without dying.

achievements.description: Complete all Act Quests with a character
achievements.summary: Complete all 27 Act quests with one character.

guide.context: Quests per act: Act 1 has six (Den of Evil, Sisters' Burial Grounds, Search for Cain, Forgotten Tower, Tools of the Trade, Sisters to the Slaughter). Act 2 has six (Radament's Lair, Horadric Staff, Tainted Sun, Arcane Sanctuary, The Summoner, Seven Tombs). Act 3 has six (Golden Bird, Blade of the Old Religion, Khalim's Will, Lam Esen's Tome, Blackened Temple, The Guardian). Act 4 has three (Fallen Angel, Hell's Forge, Terror's End). Act 5 has six (Siege on Harrogath, Rescue on Mount Arreat, Prison of Ice, Betrayal of Harrogath, Rite of Passage, Eve of Destruction).

steps.text: Open the quest log in each act and finish every quest on one character.
Compare the log with the full quest list.

achievements.description: Equip a complete set
achievements.summary: Equip every piece of one item set.

guide.context: Sets have 3 to 5 pieces, and drops are random.

steps.text: Pick one low-level set and collect all of its pieces.
Wear all the pieces at the same time.

achievements.description: Successfully complete a rune word
achievements.summary: Complete a runeword.

steps.text: Get a sword, mace or axe that has exactly two sockets.
Insert @item{Tir}, then @item{El}, in that order. This makes Steel, which needs level 13.

achievements.displayName: Rus Do Fah So La Te Do!
achievements.description: Upgrade a Rune using the Horadric Cube
achievements.summary: Upgrade a rune in the Horadric Cube.

guide.context: Any three identical lower runes work.

steps.text: Put three El runes in the @item{Horadric Cube} and press Transmute to get an Eld.

achievements.description: Acquire a unique item from gambling
achievements.summary: Get a unique item from gambling.

guide.context: Gambling gets costlier as your level rises.

steps.text: Save a lot of gold, then make a new low-level character; about level 11 works.
Gamble with @npc{Gheed} in Act 1, buying daggers until a unique (gold name) appears.
Refresh his stock if no dagger is offered.
